       - If `ts[j]` is 1 and `hs[as[j]]` is false, increments `cnt[xs[j]]` by `w`, decrements `h`, and sets `hs[as[j]]` to true.
       - If `ts[j]` is not 1 and `ws[as[j]]` is false, increments `cnt[xs[j]]` by `h`, decrements `w`, and sets `ws[as[j]]` to true.
    8. Increments `cnt[0]` by the product of `h` and `w`.
    9. Initializes a map to store non-zero values from `cnt`.
    10. Iterates over `cnt`, adding entries with positive values to the map.
    11. Outputs the size of the map.
    12. Sorts the map entries by value in reverse order and collects them into a new map (bug is here).
    13. Iterates over the sorted map entries, printing each key-value pair.
    14. Flushes the output stream.
]
